notes.title: Minor fix patch
notes.notes:
Thanks to the community for spotting a few (hopefully) final rare bugs:


 Fixed a rare instance of some short term injuries sometimes 'healing' a fighter in their transition residual phase before disappearing. This only ever lasted one week before being auto-fixed anyway, which is why it has gone unnoticed so long, but hopefully now squashed.
 Fixed an issue with some permanent damage to agility not saving properly between saves.
 Fixed the display of 'expected crowd' in the selection screen to properly show the crowd.

notes.title: Roman Name Update!
notes.notes:
Thanks to Kobrelo for doing a lot of the legwork on this one and giving me some useful information on Roman naming conventions.

Roman names are now a lot more various and sophisticated.

Citizens, veterans and criminals will now be named using praenomen-nomen or nomen-cognomen conventions. Slaves will now have single names from a wider pool.

Either way there should now be a lot more variety and even a few more of the somewhat mad combinations for those of you who enjoy the 'Totally random' setting like me! :)

notes.title: Anniversary Update!
notes.notes:
Tomorrow is the one year anniversary since the release of Gladiator Manager!

I can't thank the player base enough for a really wonderful year with sales that exceeded my hopes, and loads of fantastic feedback (mainly positive, but also very helpful constructive criticism too). I won't say the game is quite a polished article (I'm not exactly AAA, operating out of my basement in my spare time) but it's very close to bug free (in fact I'm only aware of one minor outstanding bug in the whole game), and certainly in full working order.

I've therefore decided to call this latest release v.2.0 in honour of the anniversary, and how far the game has come since those dodgy early days before the players helped me wipe out a plethora of bugs, and refined the gameplay to its present awesome state.

Now that it's all working so well I'm going to call it complete. I could let feature creep keep me going for the rest of my life, but I have several other projects I want to give live too, so watch this space in a couple of years.

I will still be providing full technical support for the game in case of any serious new bugs that are discovered (and let's be honest, every update usually breaks something, somewhere) so please keep dropping by the discussion forums and stay in touch.

Thanks again to the players for an amazing year!

Changelog:

Gameplay / Presentation

 Added a cup history table to the league history screen (now re-titled ‘competition history’) accessible from the League page. This will show past cup winners, and it will work with your save game, but only prospectively for new winners – the record of past winners before this patch is lost.
 Added quite a few more rare random events.
 Added tooltips in barracks screen to explain Mood and Condition



Fixes / Optimisation

 Fixed a bug preventing the ‘free agent’ table from displaying properly.
 Improved the stability of the quick sim live mode, hopefully avoiding possible bugs cropping up at the end of the battle.
 Fixed a bug that was causing problems with loading and then re-loading different saves.
 Fixed an issue with portrait not saving properly if you just use the random button and then quit to main menu before clicking save and exit.
 Fixed crowd resetting to 3118 when loading from an autosave
 Fixed a bug that was preventing the ‘Recover Net’ skill from working properly.
 Fixed unlucky/lucky tooltip for manager traits.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: AI MANAGERS!
notes.notes:
An exciting new feature in this update: each team now has an AI manager with a name and a personality!

This feels like a key part of world building and story telling, that I know a lot of you are keen on. I hope that it should result in more of a unique vibe to the different teams as they get slowly molded to the image of their manager.


New Feature - AI Managers!


 AI Managers have names and personalities; you can see this information under the enemy fighter table in the team selection screen.
 AI Manager traits affect all areas of the game, from in fight decision making to team selection and financial management.
 Teams that get sacked will replace their manager with a random new manager.
 This new feature is save game compatible. The first time you load up after downloading the patch, the game will populate managers for all teams. 
 However, the impact on an already existing save might take a while to filter through. For example, a manager with a preference for hiring Rogues will take a while to change the composition of the team – they are obviously not just going to sack the whole team and replace it over night – they are still sane.
 The effects are all relatively subtle, as you would hope, so bizarre or ridiculous behaviours should not be seen, but they ought to give teams a degree of character in the long run, and maybe even give you some rival managers to try to beat!
 There are 13 categories of trait, and around 75 subcategories in total. Most managers will have two traits, but some will have only one, or maybe even none.
 You can find out what the traits do by hovering over the ‘?’ next to the trait names in the team selection screen. For now I’ll leave it as a surprise for you to find them all out but if anyone wants a list or more info, stop by the steam discussion forum!



Other Fixes and Changes


 Increased the energy loss resulting from trip / barge / tangle to make those special moves a little less OP. You'll now need a fighter with great stamina if you want to keep spamming trips!
 Fixed an issue with the ’10 win streak’ bonus event identifying the wrong fighter for the reward. This bug was also causing the end of season winners and awards to bug out.
 Fixed an issue with AI targeting severed body parts.
 Added more rare events.
 Significant improvement to database stability that should prevent corrupted broken games when odd things are done like quitting in the middle of generating a new game.

notes.title: V.1.37 Maintenance Patch
notes.notes:
This week's patch is packed full of less exciting but important minor fixes and balance changes. Thanks to the community for the help and suggestions getting these sorted.

Gameplay / Balance


 Increased the condition gain/loss from easy/hard training by 50%.
 Decreased the chances of getting gains to max Potential from training focus.
 Increased crowd attendance in divisions 1 & 2, hopefully leading to more money for top division teams and thus more chance to afford higher quality veterans etc. Making those divisions more challenging, but more rewarding too.


User Interface

 Added a column to the barracks table to show training focus and intensity.
 Added a battle log which can be found in your Steam Gladiator Manager directory in the folder “GladiatorManager_data”. The file is called log.txt and records only the text of the most recent battle.



Fixes


 Fixed a bug causing top division simulation crashes that was occasional in high number fight weeks (3v3, 4v4, like week 10).
 Fixed a bug causing the AI not to take proper account of condition when picking fighters against other AI teams. You should see fewer completely exhausted opponents now.
 Fixed a bug causing the AI to sometimes select the same fighter twice against the player team.
 Fixed a bug causing the cup final to be replayed in week 52 if the player won it in week 51.
 Fixed a bug causing relationships to persist and carry over to replacement fighters after contract expiry.
 Fixed some minor gender reporting errors.
 Fixed a bug occasionally allowing fighters to go >100 or <1 on mood/condition following a battle.

notes.title: Major Update - New Class! v1.36
notes.notes:
A very exciting update this week with a brand new class joinging the fight!

THE FREESTYLER!


 Brand new fighter class: the Freestyler
 Freestylers have a similar chance to generate as Gladiators, and will more commonly be Citizens. They will start to appear in current save games as well as new games.
 Freestylers typically have much better Initiative, as well as higher bravery and weapon skill
 They will often have very bad discipline and poor leadership
 Freestylers fight with a sword AND a club! They can use horizontal cutting attacks as well as vertical overhead smash and crush attacks
 They have average leather armour (same as Gladiator and Leader)
 Freestyler perks are completely random - you will get three random options to choose from instead of just one
 Freestylers have no advantage over any class, and are not vulnerable to any class so they are a good buffer in any line up to prevent being outclassed.
 They have a special passive ability which triggers whenever they lose discipline: a) there is no discipline penatly to attack or defence; and b) there is a chance (dependant on Initiative) to predict the opponent's choice of move and counter it - i.e. attacking if the opponent is defending, and vice versa, and picking the best kind of attack or defence to counter the opponent's choice - i.e. choosing to dodge against a vertical attack. This makes them great automous reactive fighters.



Other Gameplay changes in this update


 Gave the AI the ability and intelligence to use the new training intensity settings to maximis improvement while maintaining condition and mood as far as possible.
 Training ‘focus’ now carries a very small chance to increase the fighter’s max potential in the relevant attribute – adding further purpose to carefully selecting a focus. The chance is heavily dependent upon Work Ethic. Applies to AI teams as well.
 Slightly increased the chances of generating criminals in Division 1. There are now 50% fewer criminals rather than 80% fewer in the top league.



Bug Fixes


 Finally fixed the disappearing convicts bug. The fighters (and convicts) should now properly load when you find yourself up against a team without enough fighters.
 Fixed a bug that was sometimes causing win/loss/kill streaks to carry over from a retiring/dead fighter to their database replacement. This was also causing some instances of graveyard streak errors and bounty streak errors.
 Fixed a small bug that was slightly limiting the potential of leadership to be really high on generation.
 Fixed a bug causing certain level 6 perks to sometimes be displayed with the wrong icon in the perk tree.
 Fixed a bug causing some perks to be shown in the wrong colour in the perk bar on the profile / barracks screen.

notes.title: Major Update - Condition!
notes.notes:
Work on Condition has now been finished - pairing it as a persistent energy state alongside persistent mood, making player and AI selection a little more interesting. I hope you like it!

Condition


 Condition attribute added to all fighters. Should work with existing saves. All fighters in game will start at 70/100 condition.
 Condition can be seen in barracks or in the selection table. Enemy condition is also visible on selection (unlike mood - on the basis that your scouts can assess condition of the enemy by checking them out and looking at recent fights, but they cannot know their mood).
 Condition varies randomly from week to week but if the fighter is healthy and in training then it will tend towards 100/100.
 The amount of Condition gained each week is heavily dependant on a fighter's Recovery attribute - giving that thus far underused attribute more meaning in the game.
 Condition reduces after a fight to reflect cumulative exhaustion and wear and tear. The longer the fight the more condition will be lost, up to a maximum loss of 30 condition per fight. The amount lost is heavily dependent on Stamina.
 Low Condition will result in faster energy loss during a fight. The further below 100 the more chance of faster loss.
 High Condition (>80) may give buffs to attack and defence.
 Low Condition ( <70) may give nerfs to attack and defence.
 AI will take condition into account when selecting the team. Fighters below 90 condition are increasingly less likely to be selected by the AI, with those below 50 usually left on the bench to recover. However, just like the player, if the AI is short on fighters they may be forced into using tired fighters anyway.



Other Fixes and Tweaks in this Version


 Added colour coding to the recruit table to make it easier to see good attributes at a glance
 Fixed an issue with the new news presentation spacing out between screen switches.
 Fixed a database corruption bug causing secondary crashes on re-load after a break or crash in simulations caused a restart.
 Text speed now saves properly between fights
 Fixed a bug occasionally making expired fighters hang around for ages taking up recruitment space. These should now properly disappear in the next 4-week cycle.
 Added a normal battle log when fighters are defending well because of good mood, or badly because of bad mood.

notes.title: 1.25 Update - Quality of Life
notes.notes:
A couple of long standing and repeated quality of life requests have been introduced with this weekend's update:

News Screen

The news screen now provides information in a structured and logical way with important announcements at the top, visible in red where particularly urgent.


New Recruit Table


 The barracks table now comes with a button to toggle to viewing all available recruits. 
 To compress the scouting information into tabular form recruits are now graded A-I in each visible attribute (but as before some attributes cannot be seen at all).
 This table can be sorted but be warned that a fighter whose sorted attribute has not been scouted will drop to the bottom of the table, and so if you only ever rely on sorting particular attributes you might miss the occasional gem - always best to look across the board to try to guess which fighters might be best.

notes.title: Introducing 'Mood' - a v.1.24 NEW FEATURE update
notes.notes:
Now that the game is 95% stable I have had time to start working on new features.

I've created some infrastructure in the code to support an 'event' system which I will be introducing slowly in the coming weeks / couple of months.

In the meantime this week's brand new feature is MOOD


MOOD


 All fighters now have a 'Mood' attribute which can be seen in barracks and the selection screen.
 Base level mood is 70. When a fighter is higher or lower than 70 that will have impacts on morale. attack and defence in fight.
 Mood randomly fluctuates each week, with a tendency to drift back towards the 60-80 range over time. There is also a slight weight in favour of increases, to offset mood loss from injuries.
 Mood is slightly affected for better or worse by the team's result, regardless of whether the fighter was involved.
 Mood is positively affected by a fighter achieving a rating of >5 in battle, and negatively affected when rating is 80) can result in:
[olist]
    Slower morale loss after a flesh wound
    Reduced chance to yield
    The occasional increase in chance to hit
    The occasional increase in defence skill
[/olist]
 The more extreme the mood, the more the chance that one of these effects will trigger. 
 There are full descriptions of the mechanic changes in the detailed battle view, and once in while when mood really makes the difference that will be reported in normal battle view.
 The AI will sometimes take mood into account in selecting its team.



Other bits and pieces in this update


 Ever so slightly increased energy recovery.
 AI v AI selection is now a little less rigid (just as it is in player v AI fights) which should result in greater rotation in AI teams, putting less pressure on their star fighters and developing others.
 Further French translation.

notes.title: Regular Update; v.1.23
notes.notes:
Gameplay / Balancing



 Scaled XP gains up for higher divisions to reflect greater experience from the tougher fights in higher divisions and to counterbalance the fact that there is a lot more death and permanent injury in the higher divisions so it is harder to get a fighter fully levelled up. XP now gains 10% faster per division (i.e. 10% faster in div 4 up to 40% faster in div 1).
 Reduced salaries slightly across the board but especially for low current ability citizens, to encourage the player to develop youngsters.



UI / Presentation


 Made combat log window draggable so it can be repositioned in the battle screen. Can be dragged by clicking and holding ‘battle report’, ‘detailed report’ or ‘Hold’.
 Removed ‘Help’ tab from battle report – this was a legacy feature now replaced by tooltips and the help screen.
 Class advantage perks now show up in the correct colour (i.e. matching the target class) in barracks view.
 Fixed some minor formatting issues in battle help screens
 Minor tutorial and tooltip corrections to reflect post-balancing alterations.
 Added more French translation.
 Fighters now appear in the player’s graveyard after only one fight
 The Graveyard now shows class, origin and brief details of death (or retirement).

notes.title: Regular Update; v.1.21
notes.notes:
A selection of little improvements while I've been working on implementing an events system which should start to appear in a week or less (albeit with very few events to start with).


Gameplay and Balancing


 ‘Management’ difficulty level now also affects training speed.
 Using a perk to improve an attribute now improves the ‘trained’ level of the attribute rather than the base level, so that the gain can be seen more easily as part of the (+#) on training gain view.
 Capped maximum salaries and reduced top level citizen and veteran salaries
 Increased citizen and veteran fees slightly
 Reduced criminal potential (and therefore current) ability by around half a star across the board to reduce reliance (by player and AI) on cheap criminal fighters.
 Reduced generation frequency of criminals in division 1 by 50% to stratify that division properly as an elite league with elite fighters (most div 1 teams are also arguably too wealthy in the long run so this will also redress that).



UI and Presentation


 Changed difficulty label to say ‘Management’ instead of ‘economy / recruitment’.
 Replaced leadership with stamina in ‘S’ card front view. I am told, and have experienced, that stamina is more useful to be able to quickly see.
 Progressed French Translation a little further.
 Added a handful of new (ancient world) team names that might come up in ‘Totally Random’ game theme mode.
 Optimised initial loading somewhat so the main menu should now load slightly faster on starting up the game.



Fixes


 Prevented Barbarians, Defenders and Retarii from getting the ‘Forearm Slash’ perk – just doesn’t feel thematically right (does not affect existing fighters).
 Fixed a bug with the Disarm perk.

notes.title: Difficulty Modes! Update to Version 1.2
notes.notes:
I'm excited to be releasing further custom difficulty options with this update!

There are now two difficulty settings that can be altered both on starting a new game and at any time from the Options screen in-game:

Economic / Recruitment Difficulty

This affects income from battles and the quality of recruits that are offered every four weeks during the season. There are four modes ranging from 'Easy' to 'Nightmare'. Easy mode allows the player a more relaxed financial simulation with generally higher quality recruits on offer. Hard and Nightmare modes, on the other hand, give those bonuses to the AI, making for tougher campaigns.


Battle Difficulty

Battle Difficulty settings are, for now, quite simple. They operate by giving either the player or the AI global bonuses to attack, defence and damage, jumping on the back of the perk/advantage system.

Easy mode gives the player a 10% universal advantage in all battles, while Hard and Nightmare give 10% and 20% advantages to the AI instead.


'Normal' settings will make no difference to the current game - so if you are happy with the balance as it is, just leave the game on Normal!


Future Plans

Once I have some feedback on whether 'Easy' is really easy enough, and 'Nightmare' is really hard enough, I plan to create a semi-Ironman mode for Hard & Nightmare where those difficulty settings will only be changeable on starting a new game and will not be alterable thereafter.

I then intend to release a limited number of bonus achievements that will only be possible in Hard and Nightmare Ironman modes.


Other balancing, fixes and presentation changes in v.1.2


 Ever so slightly reduced energy loss for all fighters during battle.
 Fixed a bug with AI team selection vs the player when enemy had some healthy fighters but not enough for a complete team. This was creating duplicates and strange crashes. (FYI – sometimes the AI will desperately sign a new fighter just to make up numbers at the last minute, so they may not always appear on the selection screen – though surprise last minute signings will usually be poor, the AI having previously decided they weren’t good enough but being forced into signing them to make up the numbers).
 Fixed some minor issues with presentation of perk/class advantages in Detailed Battle Report.
 Fixed a minor colour presentation bug in Detailed Battle Report.

notes.title: Regular Update; v.1.19
notes.notes:
Bits and pieces today

Gameplay / Balancing


 Major balance change: Gladiator class now gets a buff to potential weapon skill on creation and a corresponding nerf to leadership, to give them a bit more character and appeal. (Won’t affect existing Gladiators, only newly generated ones).
 Further refinements to citizens’ salaries. Now slightly cheaper when they are young and undeveloped, and slightly pricier once they get good.
 Gave a +5 to current attribute value to whichever attribute the player chooses on starting a new game for the player-character focus, to make that decision slightly more meaningful.



UI / Presentation


 Minor spelling edits on tooltips.
 Made play-off weeks much more obvious, with a tutorial pop-up, notice in news panel and note next to team name in selection screen.
 Highlighted the attribute that the player-character focussed on in creation in light blue (only works for new saves).



Fixes / Edits



 Further ‘Entrench’ bug fixed.
 Fixed a bug nerfing player team recruits in higher divisions. Anyone in a higher div should see much better offerings now. Let me know how that affects difficulty – arguably could get a little too easy even though player and AI are now on an equal playing field. More difficulty options planned.
 Fixed a short-term bug with tooltips in the barracks arising from the last patch.
 Fixed a bug making the player pay a signing fee twice when re-signing fighters out of contract.
 Fixed a couple of bugs affecting the ZeroIn perk.

notes.title: Regular Update: v.1.18
notes.notes:
Massive thanks today to my great friend Nick who has composed a new track for the game out of the goodness of his heart. If you hear an unfamiliar track that'll be his. It's just over four minutes long and really suits the game perfectly. If you like what you hear check out some of his meditation music on the Insight Timer app.

Gameplay / Balancing


 Exp gain from killing / knocking out opponents slightly increased; exp from suffering an injury slightly reduced.
 Fighters can no longer roll for a special move attack if they are disarmed or fallen.
 Popularity loss when losing to a team in a higher division in the cup capped at -3.
 Adjusted Player Character Int and WE back up a bit since the progress was a little *too* nerfed.



UI / Presentation


 Added a whole new 4 minute music track to the game, composed especially for Gladiator Manager by my very good friend Nicholas G. James esq..
 Barracks screen now available (mostly) in French.
 Clarified perk text for ‘Reinforce’.



Fixes


 ‘Rage’ now benefits from class advantage and other status effects as intended.
 Criminal fighters with multiple injuries can now be fired as long as at least one of them is over 42 days.
 Barracks now correctly displays positive consequences of permanent injuries.
 Fixed a bug affecting ‘Entrench’ and ‘Disappear’ and the associated achievements.

notes.title: Regular Update: v1.17
notes.notes:
Catching up on some great suggestions and useful bug reports over the weekend, this is an all-rounder patch that.... well... fixes the 'All Rounder' perk. And some other stuff!


Gameplay / Balancing


 Minor adjustments to generation parameters. Criminals are now slightly less likely to be rogues (that was too overwhelming a probability) and slightly more likely to be barbarians/defenders/leaders. Slaves are now slightly less likely to be barbarians (again, was too common) and slightly more likely to be defenders/leaders. Should start to see more defenders / leaders now.
 Slight reduction to citizen salaries across the board.
 Player Character’s salary is now capped to 500 or 1/5 of team total spend, whichever is the higher (but, for the avoidance of doubt, if their ‘natural’ salary is less than that cap it stays at that lower value).



UI / Display


 Changes to blood loss rate from minor injuries now recorded in detailed battle report.
 Added speed, stamina and leadership info to the injury table in the barracks screen. Shrunk the titles to ensure it fits all resolutions.
 Convicts (AI sub glads for when team is out of fighters) are now distinguished in the battle reports (i.e. no longer just says “Convict advances to attack” but “Convict Three advances to attack”.
 Added info about the current bleed rate to the ‘Health’ card front display.
 Added a tutorial note in week 3 for players finding it difficult.
 Player fighter xp gain is now also visible in battle results screens displaying 2v2, 3v3 and 4v4 results.



Fixes


 Fixed a bug allowing fighters to defend AND rest in a single move on discipline break.
 “Eyeballing” dead player fighters (misreporting in the detailed report) now hopefully fixed.
 Fixed a bug that was sometimes randomising number of fighters during league matches in certain weeks after week 37.
 Fixed a bug with the all rounder and class destroyer perks. No doubt these will now trigger immediately for lots of people!
 Angled Attack no longer (erroneously) gives the bonus if the fighter with that perk breaks discipline during the move.

notes.title: V.1.16 - Regular Update
notes.notes:
Apologies for the slower progress this week. Been very busy in the day job.

Excited for the future of this project but still in the polishing zone for now.

One major development is the VERY small start on a French translation. Watch out for progress on this in the coming month. This is thanks to Tchey's volunteering with the French. If anyone is interesting in helping out with other languages then do get in touch!

And while I'm thanking people specifically, I feel I owe particular thanks to Myll and Xuande for some really great specific bug reporting and ideas. Much appreciated guys.

Language

Began the French translation! Approx 2.5% complete (i.e. almost nothing). But Tchey has already given me a lot more to start implementing.


Gameplay / Balancing


 Forced bleed out death for any fighter who drops below 1 blood (I had reports of some uber-tough fighters sticking it out with no blood! Most will bleed out or fall unconscious long before this).
 Removed the possibility of ever failing an energy roll on 90+ energy (it was already very unlikely on 70+ but now impossible for 90+).
 Forced team backer to recalculate team budgets every week instead of every fourth week so that the correct budgets are always displayed and there’s no need to go to ‘finance’ and use the slider to get the true value anymore.
 Made it easier for fighters to stand / rearm if opponent is resting.
 Prevented fighters from missing out on a combination finisher by running out of energy – that’s just not satisfying (I had already prevented discipline fails at this point for the same reason).



UI / Presentation


 Added a tutorial in the 8th week to teach the player more about how training works.
 Added labels to fight screen to explain that the red sphere = blood and the blue sphere = armour.
 Removed an obsolete options button from the blood sphere.


Fixes


 Fixed a bug causing display issues in the Barracks when the player went Barracks -> Home -> League -> Barracks (from clicking their team in the table).
 Removed some erroneous and confusing references to team leaders in the detailed bleed out roll log.
 Fixed player not being able to level up a fighter when they have exactly the right amount of exp rather than more (i.e. 1500 on the nose for level 2).
 Fixed various bugs resulting from the new mortality options.
 Fixed home screen news sometimes repeating during an rest / cup . play-off week.
 Fixed a bug that was causing problems with recovery from the ‘punctured throat’ injury.

notes.title: v.1.15 Regular Update
notes.notes:
Miscellaneous fixes and the NEW OPTION to hide potentials / work ethic / intelligence - available in-game on the options screen for that extra added difficulty challenge!

Gameplay / Presentation


 Added an option to hide Potential, Work Ethic and Intelligence either for all fighters or just for scouting purposes if desired.
 Made positive attributes changes from ‘Anger’ (to bravery and str) show up with a ‘+’ and in green.
 Prevented fighters from training back up to full potential despite permanent injury effects. Those permanent effects now reduce the maximum attainable level of the attribute as expected.



Fixes


 Fixed an issue with not being able to sack some heavily injured criminals.
 Fixed a bug causing AI fighters to lose all speed, stamina and leadership when injured. (Also added an auto-fix that will test your save for this problem and restore the lost s/s/l if necessary).
 Fixed text disappearing in options screen on certain resolutions.
 Fixed a bug preventing fighters from recovering from temporary blindness (due to the ‘Sun’ leader perk).
 Fixed ‘S’ card front displays to show changes to attributes from injuries and status effects more accurately 
 Fixed a bug preventing status effects (dazed, angry etc.) from actually changing attributes on some occasions (the display showed them as changed, but they weren’t).
 Fixed an issue allowing fighters to gain attributes through combat training in excess of potential when injured during that fight.

notes.title: Update to v.1.13
notes.notes:
Hello and thanks again for the continued feedback and reporting.

I managed to take my first day off yesterday since release and nothing was reported broken in my absence, so I'm taking that as a major win! definitely into the polishing phase now.

Changelist for today's update. All changes affect saved games unless otherwise stated.


Gameplay / Balancing


 Toned down and capped the dramatic team popularity changes.
 Increased the chances of AI teams sacking permanently maimed fighters.
 Having nerfed the player-character (‘PC’) intelligence and work ethic to ensure much slower development over several seasons, that was creating too bad a penalty on PC experience gain. PC xp gain is therefore now independent of intelligence and has a minimum of 25 if on the winning team. Your PCs should therefore start levelling up again at a more reasonable rate.
 Further tweaks to AI team management to further improve its skill at managing the budgets sensibly.



Fixes / Editing


 Fixed player graveyard tooltips to appear above the graveyard to avoid going offscreen.
 (Possibly) fixed odd rare instances of dead fighters being mentioned in the battle log. Still not 100% that I’ve caught it but I’ve tracked one possible issue and added some safeguards. Let me know if you see this again and if you do a screenshot of the detailed battle report would be awesome – please post in steam discussion forums.
 Minor editing to various help screens.
 Fixed an issue preventing a player from sacking a criminal who had been injured for >= 42 days where they had a second injury on <42 days.
 Fixed a bug making the class advantage achievements harder to trigger (it wasn’t counting the original 25%). Still nobody has made it to 100%+, notwithstanding this bug!
 The option to maintain a ‘Press’ that had been selected the previous turn will now correctly disappear when control drops below 51.
 Tutorials on unwise ‘control’ decisions no longer trigger when the fighter has caused the situation by disobeying the player due to ill-discipline.
 Fixed saving the Cup History in Team History so it no longer bizarrely says “Rock Solid” in that column for future seasons. The cup records for old seasons in existing saves are lost – sorry.
 Fixed a bug in the combat AI making AI less likely to go for combination moves when they involved a defensive aspect. AI should now use (or rather try to use) combination moves more often.
 Minor typo corrections to tooltips.

notes.title: Tuesday Patch
notes.notes:
Today's patch notes...

All affect save games unless otherwise stated.


Gameplay / Balancing


 Loss of attributes from age now slowed further if fighter has good work ethic and training focus is set to the attribute you want to preserve. N.B. mental attributes are immune to age decline anyway.
 Fighters can now freely disengage when their opponent has fallen.
 Injuries now re-load properly when you re-load into the middle of a fight.
 Made enemy AI more aggressive and less likely to keep defending when >50 control.
 Prevented a fighter who fails an energy check on attacking from ‘jumping back’ to prevent a counterattack
 Further tweaked AI team management to try to improve decision making on hiring and firing.
 Encouraged AI to attack more when flanking and ‘outflank’ less.
 Increased base (and minimum) energy recovery on resting from 10 -> 12
 Slightly increased chances of AI deciding to rest when needing energy.



UI / Text / Engine


 Added total career damage dealt and taken to the drop options in the player records screen.
 Added a label on character creation screen to let the player know the ID# of the different portrait parts in case they want to recreated that portrait later.
 Correct achievement descriptions for 5 killer and 10 killer – both of which require kill streaks rather than total kills – this is one of the toughest achievements in the game, but a handful of people have managed it!
 Optimised “scouting for new fighters” in every fourth week. It was getting slower as the game moved along. This is now fixed and it should remain more or less lightning fast now however many seasons you have completed.



Fixes / Amendments


 Injuries now re-load properly when you re-load into the middle of a fight.
 Re-loading mid battle now correctly re-loads fighter energy.

notes.title: Major Balance Patch, v1.1
notes.notes:
I've been concentrating on trying to improve the challenge in the game, without making it unduly hard for new players. In discussion with various extremely helpful players I've been making a number of tweaks. Let me know what you think on the Steam message boards.

Perfecting balance remains a WIP, and I remain open to suggestions. It really feels a lot improved in just one week thanks to your help.

Look out for the useful middle button scroll function in the barracks now as well - makes it super fast to scroll quickly through prospects!

All changes affect save games unless otherwise stated.

Gameplay and Balancing


 Player characters will now develop slightly slower (does not affect existing saves).
 Player character wages will now be cheaper (will affect current saves but only on PC contract extension).
 All fighter training gains are now capped at 5 (instead of 10 as it was before) and getting more than 4/5 points gained in a week is now unusual.
 To counter the fact that lower div fighters are often pathetically weak and unskilled, which can lead to long armour chipping contests at the beginning of the game, I have reduced armour coverage by 20 in div5, 15 in div4, 10 in div3 and 5 in div2. The in-game rationale is cheaper armour for cheaper divisions.
 To match the new armour rationale, I have reduced armour repair costs by 20% in div5 and so to match the cheaper and reduced coverage.
 Improved AI hiring / extension / firing decision making to hopefully improve AI squads in higher leagues.
 Rogues now need to do at least 3 flesh damage to cause the extra bleeding effects, so completely trivial cuts will no longer have such an impact.
 Slightly reduced base damage for Pommel from 4 to 3.
 Gave a variable but roughly 25% boost to fighters defending against a ShoulderBarge / Trip / Tangle so those special moves are now harder to pull off. They were overpowered and the in game rationale is that they should be difficult things to achieve.



UI and Quality of Life


 Added mouse wheel scroll functionality to the barracks. Scrolling middle button now scrolls through the fighters.
 Added a toggle just about the battle report area to fix on ‘basic’ or ‘detailed’ view so you can watch it come out line by line in detailed view if you want to.
 Made the negative injury effect numbers in the barracks much brighter for better readability.
 Gave the attribute font in barracks a little outline to stand out for better readability.
 Optimised autosaves so that loading into battle should be significantly faster for those playing in seasons 2/3+.



Fixes and improvements


 Prevented fighters from acting after they have had their position forcibly swapped by an adjacent fighter, and likewise prevented anyone targeting them from following through on any attack. This not only prevents bugs but makes sense in-game: the fighter is physically pull aside by their moving team mate, yanking them out of trouble but leaving them unable to act for the rest of the turn (unless they got in a move before being swapped).
 Fighter contracts can now be extended where salary budget is greater than the difference between the old salary cost and the new (used to have to be able to cover the entire new salary rather than just the difference). So this makes it easier to extend existing contracts within budget.
 Prevented kills in play-offs from registering towards the league table, sometimes changing team position after season close and causing gremlins.
 Activated ‘Destroyer’, ‘Conqueror’ and ‘Punching Bag’ achievements. If you are 2-3 seasons in these might trigger immediately.
 Fixed exclamation mark icon not disappearing when opposing fighter died / yielded.
 Fixed a ‘&’ that should’ve been a ‘%’ in 4th level perk descriptions.
 Fallen and disarmed fighters can no longer work out a combination move.
 Fixed a bug displaying incorrect contract extension amounts on page 2 of the barracks.
 Fixed new gender option not sticking after selection in new game.
 Prevented player changing card front in mid battle sequence – was causing some minor bugs.
 Fixed a bug making player rogues marginally more effectively at bleeding opponents than enemy rogues.

notes.title: Bumper Weekend Update: v.109
notes.notes:
Gladiator Manager is settling nicely now with minimal major bugs. We're into the remote and the obscure, and that's freed me up for a few little balance tweaks and QOL improvements. Thanks for the continued feedback, feels like the game is really taking shape now!

Changelist (all items affect saved games unless they say otherwise):

Gameplay / Balance


 Increased citizen wages slightly across the board. 
 Increased citizen signing fees slightly across the board.
 Increased wages and signing fees still further for truly exceptional citizens and veterans.
 Increased starting money for all teams on a new game (doesn't affect current saves).
 All existing saves get a one time bonus cash injection of £5,000 to help with these changes when first loading up and cycling through a week (this was uploaded yesterday so you may not have noticed).
 Increased crowd sizes and therefore income for all divisions with a further bonus for div 5 (biggest increase), 4 (medium increase) and 3 (small increase).
 All teams (AI and player) get a financial rescue if they go further than 10,000 into debt. They will be funded to prevent further debt but will still have to balance the books by sacking expensive players if they want to start signing new players again.
 Reduced ability of player team starting ‘bonus’ fighters a little now that the 1/75 bug has been removed and div5 is generally easier.
 Likewise reduced intelligence and work ethic of player characters on starting new games so that they don’t become such monsters until seasons 2/3 or later (doesn't affect current saves).
 Added bonus damage to armour for high control (1% damage bonus for every 1 control over 50).
 Prevented armour coverage and condition rolls from exceeding 100, so fighters can no longer bypass perfect (100) coverage/condition.
 Armour coverage rolls must now be > coverage to bypass, rather than >= as it was before. (This now accords with the ‘detailed report’ description).
 A fighter that is too tired to defend will now also be too tired to defend against any secondary attacks that turn from other flanking or opposing fighters. 



UI / QOL


 New gender option available both in the options screen in-game and on starting a new game. Can set newly generated fighters to ‘mixed’ (standard) / ‘male only’ or ‘female only’.
 Improved descriptions for Angled Attack.
 Added a warning to the player in the weekly news when a fighter maxes out on their training focus. The warning does not trigger if the fighter is essentially maxed out on all attributes as most of the older fighters are. Training these fighters is not pointless – it can help stave off losses, so setting a focus for older fighters will help maintain that attribute.



Fixes


 Fixed the now infamous week 2 (for season 2+) bug (I really hope). It was a play-off issue from the season before. If anyone has a broken save in week2 season2+ feel free to DM me and I will fix your save – it’s no trouble and only takes 2 minutes.
 ‘Forearm Slash’ icon in action bar now displays correctly (it erroneously was using the Shatter Shield icon).
 Fixed a bug making Angled Attack bonus trigger for player when enemy used it. 
 Fixed a typo preventing the ‘Homoclassius’ achievement from triggering.

notes.title: Version 1.08
notes.notes:
Thanks as always for the helpful feedback and reports!

Changelog:

Gameplay

Newly generated fighters will no longer see duplicate perks in the ‘random’ column. *** Does not apply to pre-existing fighters before this patch, but will apply to newly generated fighters in existing saves.


UI

1.	Added type and contract length info in the news death reports.
2.	Added a button on fighter selection table to take you to that fighter’s profile in barracks (now - hopefully - fully working).


Fixes

1.	Fixed an obscure bug that was scrambling the current attributes of about 1/75 AI fighters about one every four weeks. Anyone affected by this will have their databases automatically fixed next time they cycle through a week. You might see a drop in weirdly super powered fighters appearing in the lower divisions as a result.
2.	“Torso” now comes up properly as the title of the torso target popup.
3.	Fixed some final last masculine pronouns in female reports
4.	Fixed action bar pop-ups sometimes appearing off the bottom of the screen.
5.	Fixed a bug making press attacks 5% harder instead of 5% easier.
6.	Fixed a bug sometimes nerfing PinWeapon defence.
7.	Fixed an issue with exclamation mark sometimes disappearing when opponents swapped places or it was overrided by a less important icon.
8.	80% accuracy / defence after 5 battles now correctly triggers the relevant achievements. I imagine these will now be triggering left, right and centre, as they should be easy enough!
9.	Fixed ZeroIn active perk which wasn’t working properly
10.	Fixed a portrait glitch with black nose on white face
11.	Fixed a bug showing glitched portrait when dragging and dropping in statistics mode, then switching back to portrait mode.
12.	Fixed an issue with +attribute perk gains occasionally getting lost.

notes.title: Version 1.07
notes.notes:
Fantastic bugs and where to find them is today's theme.

I'm glad we're down to minimal / no common bugs no but a couple came up today in rare and weird circumstances that I hope most people won't have managed to contrive. Luckily they're fixed now! Thanks a ton for the reports that have helped get these fixes out there.

UI

Font size in tables adjusted throughout to generally increase it for easier readability.


Bug fixes


 Fixed a bug preventing game from autosaving hall of fame stats.
 Fixed a bug that left fighters on 0 weeks contract if you re-hired them after expiry.
 Fixed a bug that triggered on a non-gladiator class fighter trying to use ‘Press’ as an active crossover perk. It resulted in no damage when bypassing armour.
 Fixed a bug that caused mayhem with the battle calculations by putting them in a half-way house between ‘Fixed’ and ‘Dynamic’ when the player had indecisively (fairly enough) toggled between them in the options screen. If anyone has been having slow laborious fights with only 3 damage done then this is that bug and I’m really sorry. Your databases are set to autofix on loading the game so you should find that this game is now about 1000x more fun! 😊 If this is ringing a bell please quickly quick sim a fight in your save and then save and quit and re-load. This should guarantee that the database fixes itself and then you're good to go! 
 Fixed a bug triggering on use of ‘pommel’ in certain rare circumstances
 Fixed an unusual bug on season finish where sometimes a team would fail to get promoted despite winning playoffs, leaving an unbalanced number of teams in the next league and causing a crash in the first 2 weeks of the next season.

notes.title: Patch 1.06 - Tooltips
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! Thanks again for the useful feedback. Following yesterday's major UI overhaul there were a few minor teething problems, mostly fixed pretty quickly, but a few of which persisted to today. I hope they're all done now.

Version 1.06: You can see your current version at the bottom on the Main Menu screen.

All of the following will work in saved games.

UI


 The bigger fonts were making some tooltips half disappear. This should now be fixed, with tooltips behaving much better throughout and being sized and position (I hope) more appropriately.
 Added version note to main menu to allow players to be sure they are up to date. This is version 1.06.
 Saved preference for mute crowd.


Minor Rebalancing


 Armour toughness values for Rogue corrected to 2, as intended - it had accidentally gone to Barbarian who is now back up to 4.
 Barbarian damage had become OP, so base flesh damage brought back down to original value and base armour damage reduced to 19 (1 more than originally). B is still the hardest hitter in the game.
 Slightly increased energy loss for all fighters but will affect those with low stamina more.


Bug Fixing


 Fixed the brief bug that messed up a lot of stuff in the battle screen just after the major UI patch. Apologies to those of you affected in that 30-60 minute period.
 Fixed a bug that made exclamation mark sometimes appear on Retarius when they had no special move to play.
 Fixed crowd un-muting when pressing space bar to continue. 
 Prevented an overflow error on outflanking. Still not 100% clear on the root cause, but investigating.
 Fixed energy, status and morale to display correctly on the tooltip
 Fixed a bug preventing Massacre and a couple of other tier 6 perks from loading properly on the action bar.

notes.title: Major Battle UI Patch
notes.notes:
Thanks again to the community for all the great feedback. UI has been a major and repeating concern so it's been my priority. You will have seen generally larger fonts throughout the game in the last couple of days and today is a bit re-working of the battle screen.

UI


 The battle report and cards are now both much bigger.
 Battle report now displays a lot more information saving on scrolling or missing important events.
 The fighter cards can now be seen much more easily, doing more justice to my amazing artist's work on the portraits, and the attributes / armour etc. details are much easier to read.
 (I'm aware that there remain a few areas with smaller fonts, and I will look to get to them in due course.)



Bug Fixes


 Fixed a bug that prevented the game from recording and saving the new salary of a fighter on the player’s team whose contract had been renewed.
 Fixed formatting on extension button to show salary costs of extension.
 Fixed a bug that prevented player fighter contracts from dropping by a week in “rest weeks” after they had been picked to fight in the previous battle.
 Fixed a bug causing enemy fighter contracts to expire before time on occasion.
 Fixed a bug causing autosaves to lose fighter stats
 Fixed a bug that prevented options screen from displaying changes to several drop downs after they had been altered.
 Fixed a bug to do with the contract extension button. If anyone accidentally pressed it multiple times (my bad) and ended up with an overextended fighter, let me know and I’m happy to fix your save.



Minor rebalance: easter egg fighter chance reduced yet further due to too many appearing. There is now about a 29% chance of finding an easter egg if you keep the barracks half empty, in any given season.  They may not be obvious, and can appear as young fighters miles off a high potential, or maybe even grizzly veterans on the decline! :)

notes.title: Patch / Update
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

It's day 4 after release and I have another decent update package for you. I feel like the game has improved hugely in just a few days with the benefit of so much amazing feedback and help from the community. The game feels like a far better balanced challenge and the major bugs reports have almost vanished entirely. You're all really brilliant and I really appreciate the comments, reviews and reports.

This patch has a number of class tweaks in it as well as some much requested changes to font size with some options on that!

Detailed Changelog from the last 25 hours (some of these went up a while ago, others only just now):


Presentation


Massive overall to font sizes. 
[olist]
 New font size option in Options Screen (accessible from Home / News screen)
 Options for standard, smaller or larger font sizes.
 Default (standard) font size increased generally throughout the game.
 “Smaller” is close to how it looked before this patch, if you liked it how it was.
 “Larger” available for those who are still struggling.
[/olist]
 Tooltip boxes now much bigger to make for easier reading.
 Delay added to tooltips in barracks
 Put armour toughness modifiers into the main battle log to show the player more clearly how important different armour types can be and to highlight that as a major plus for the defender class.



Balance / Gameplay Changes


 Reduced rogue armour toughness from 4 to 2  because Rogues are presently overpowered and they are only wearing cloth.
 Increased Defender armour toughness from 12->13 to reflect their primary purpose of being tanks.
 Increased Barbarian damage by +2 base damage against armour (18->20) and +1 base damage (now swing = 6, smash = 13, crush & rage = 17) against flesh because they are meant to be beasts with massive clubs and are not quite cutting it at the moment.
 Increased the bonus to potential Leadership for Leaders by +5 guaranteed on generation.
 Increased the maximum team discipline gain from a successful leadership check from 20->30 to improve discipline when you have a great leader.
 Increased the maximum team bravery gain from a successful leadership check from 20->30 to improve bravery when you have a great leader.
 Prevented a fighter from failing a discipline check when performing a combination finishing move – this was just too unsatisfying / annoying. Applies to AI as well, so they cannot fail b/c of discipline either.



Bug Fixes & Editing


 Fixed a bug that prevented leaders from generated with enhanced leadership. They should now generate with much better leadership on average (although there will always be exceptions!)
 Made the minimum 20 damage to armour on combo moves take effect after armour toughness modification so it will always be at least 20.
 Fixed a temporary bug up for only a couple of hours today that removed the armour combo finisher bonus completely.
 Fixed another easter egg gender error and typo.
 Fixed a bug that very rarely nerfed recruits and indeed even possibly easter egg fighters.
 Clarified tooltip explaining ‘Guard’ perk.

notes.title: Update / Patch notes
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone enjoyingthe game and leaving positive feedback! Thanks also to all those who have reported bugs to me. I'm glad to say there have been no major bug reports for quite a while now, so I'm able to turn to some of the less pressing fixes and balances. 

The following are the changes in the last 24 hours. Some have only just been uploaded, some were uploaded a while ago but not announced.

Gameplay / Balance changes


 Gave the AI some (not much) greater unpredictability on fighter choice. It will sometimes now pick fighters based on attibutes other than just total current ability. It may also sometimes throw in youngsters or weaker fighters for experience gain / cannon fodder reasons. It will not (yet) try to outguess your selection so you can still have a good go and trying to out class advantage the enemy. More AI selection intelligence planned.
 Adjusted experience gains to increase the gains when injuring or taking out an enemy, and to reduce the amount gained when losing. N.B. Intelligence is still a MAJOR factor determining battle experience. A low intelligence fighter may get to the top perks only very slowly whereas a super smart one could get there twice as fast as average.
 Battle training gains are now linked to experience gained in battle. Low experience will cap the gain, while high exp (>250) will yield a +1 boost to the gain. The chance of a gain triggering remains mainly tied to fighter intelligence – so that remains a key stat for long-term development alongside workethic.
 Set a minimum of 20 damage to armour for combination finisher moves to make them more satisfying and avoid the damp squib feeling when they only did 6 damage.
 Added a "stagger" effect whereby a fighter suffering a flesh wound of 30 pts or more will lose control to reflect the effect of the blow. 



Fixes


 Fixed the temproary "Mithrys Nightingale" bug - this was only in existence for about an hour.
 The injury table now correctly displays in the barracks when selecting an injured gladiator from the roster table.
 Fixed a bug that preventing enemy fighters from levelling up until they had played a further fight after gaining the necessary experience.
 Fixed a bug preventing battle training gains (only in existence for a few hours between two patches).
 Roster and selection tables can now be sorted by W/L and contract length
 Fixed a bug that ended the combination move despite a successful defence which sometimes occurred when being flanked.



Editing

 Minor typo and text code corrections in tutorial pop-ups

notes.title: Major Rebalance Update!
notes.notes:
First major update for the game just uploaded.

This is a SIGNIFICANT rebalance to fighter generation in Dynamic mode. It results in far more consistent ability amoungst fighters both for the player team and the AI team. You will find that your fighters (and most of the others in division 5) will be of generally lower quality, and you won't be able to constantly pick up those super criminals. Neither will the enemy.

The fights should be closer as a result, and fighting against higher division teams in the cup will be as hard as you would expect it to be. 

Getting promoted will be way more of a challenge!

Please note that these changes WILL APPLY TO SAVED GAMES! It will not affect the ability of existing fighters in your game, but it will change how new fighters are created from now on. I know this might make it tough to take down some pre-existing OP enemies, but on the flipside the AI is getting the same nerf you are - it will also no longer generate so many high power fighters.

DETAILED UPDATE NOTES:

Rebalancing


 Completely re-worked fighter generation for 'Dynamic' RNG mode. Potential ability is now much more closely linked to league and team reputation. There is still absolultely the possibility of the occasional complete outlier appearing so keep checking those new recruits! Equally, individual attributes can still very much be unusually good or bad for any given fighter in spite of the overall ability and potential. Likewise enemy fighters will be generally much weaker in Div 5 and much stronger in the higher divisions, and they likewise have a chance to get the occasional gem [chances for AI and player are completely equal].
 Increased chance of younger fighters being further below their potential when first generated, so that there will be more 'grower' or 'hidden gem' potential fighters.
 Limited the starting current ability for the player-fighter to prevent them being too overpowered against the now weakened enemy teams. The potential is unaffected.
 You may have noticed that you always get at least one decent fighter at the start of the game as well as your player-fighter. That was intentional. That fighter is now slightly nerfed again to reflect lower ability across division 5.
 Increased chances for higher division AI managers to refuse a contract extension on weaker fighters.
 Increased the chance for AI managers to sack injured or overpaid fighters.



Bug Fixing


 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused crashes on winning cup matches.
 Fixed a bug that prevented contracts expiring on some enemy AI glads. N.B, if you are in season 2+ you might see a big drop in enemy fighter numbers as a result, but this will re-balance within 4 weeks.
 Fixed a bug preventing expiry of contracts for player's fighters when they were left unusued. N.B. If in season 2+ check you barracks to ensure you haven't left anyone's contract unextended!
 Fixed an error causing gender inappropriate ‘Easter Egg’ fighter names. Look out for these – there are a handful of super powered fighters to be found with a very small chance – but only in dynamic and roll20 modes (the names will still come up in 'fixed', but with no change to stats).
 Fixed a rare and weird bug that deleted the tutorial data base and caused a complete crash.
 Fixed a bug causing cup matches to sometimes end in a draw.
 Fixed a bug causing training gains to reset at the start of season 2.
 Gladiator names in the graveyard are now always correct.
 'For' and 'Against' tallies no longer run on to the next season.
 The league screen now defaults to the player's league on load.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented player from participating in play-offs despite qualifying.
 Fixed a bug that somes crashed the game when the player won the play-offs or made it to the final.



Minor Editing


 Adjusted wording of pop-ups on contract extension.
 Fixed some minor tutorial typo errors - a fair few more of these to come in a future patch - many thanks to Myll for editing!

notes.title: First Day Hotfix
notes.notes:
Apologies to those of you who suffered the release bug preventing play. I fixed this in about 45 minutes on release but I know it was disappointing for those of you that wanted to dive straight in. Some of you may not have been aware of the quick patch I uploaded, and I know for some people they had to restart Steam to force it to idenity and upload the patch, so if you are still having any major bug issues please restart Steam and verify the game cache. Worst case, if you haven't yet started a save, it only takes two minutes to uninstall and reinstall because the game files are small. That should clear it.

Since then I have uploaded a patch that fixes all of the following reported bugs, massive thanks to those who played the game with such enthusiasm and attention to detail on release and reported these to me quickly:

1) Stuck on main menu bug fixed.
2) "Week 1 barracks / jumping to week 3" bug fixed.
3) Armour no longer resets on re-loading mid-battle.
4) Ticking the 'random fighters in each fixture' option now works (but only from the following week to prevent re-rolling to get the number you want).
5) Added several bright reminders about the player-character's contract expiring towards the end of its span, should now be almost impossible not to notice.
6) Fixed a bug where player fighters aged by 5 instead of 1 on season end.
7) Fixed a bug preventing the "Giant Killer" and "Won the Cup" achievements from triggering.

Thanks for all the support so far, and all the great positive feedback from those of you several hours in now, it's all really appreciated!

notes.title: Upcoming Release!
notes.notes:
An extremely exciting month for Gladiator Manager – it’s release time!

It’s turning into an extremely hectic month for me as the pressure and hype ramps up ahead of full release on Steam.

There’s a great deal going on, mainly playtesting and marketing. I’m glad to say that the final few bugs seem to have been squished and there are hopefully no game-breakers left anywhere. I am touching wood.

https://i1.wp.com/gladiatormanager.net/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/4v4stabbing.png?resize=1024%2C576&ssl=1

Features

Aside from a few minor QOL improvements and Easter eggs there are no new features, as you’d hope at this stage, but I can assure players that some post-release features are certainly planned, including:

    Scouting system
    Fighter synergies (including personality and nationality)
    Achievement rewards; and
    Persistent morale and energy.

https://i1.wp.com/gladiatormanager.net/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/Untitled.png?resize=1024%2C576&ssl=1

Marketing

I’ve been slow-burning the marketing so far, mainly on Steam, Facebook, Instagram, Youtube and my own website. I’ve spent some money on it, but really only a trivial level.

This month things are ramping up for release. I have a promotor – Hans Olsen of Game Promotor – and a number of influencers on YouTube and Twitch. I have also been contacted independently by about a dozen journalists wanting to write articles. This is really cool – thanks so much to everyone helping me out!

The results of this increased activity are just beginning to show with an accelerating up-tick in wishlisting – now approaching 1,000 people on the list. I really appreciate all of you taking an interest! It’s incredibly gratifying to see people wanting to play a game I’ve spent so much time lovingly crafting.

On that note – many thanks also to my recent playtesters, and especially Crazed Redneck who has devoted many hours to playing and replaying campaigns to ferret out all those last problems. His obvious enjoyment of the game, keen to play it over and over, encourages me that I’ve managed to put together some fun features here, and I must admit I’m really enjoying playing through it myself now. Forcing myself to just play, and ignore all my instincts to quickly log out and improve some tiny visual thing or embark on a whole new feature!

https://i2.wp.com/gladiatormanager.net/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/Home.png?resize=1024%2C577&ssl=1

I’m certainly now spending more on marketing, on a ‘spend money to make money’ basis. There are quite a number of options and I won’t have to get much interest back to make those investments at least cost-neutral.

Overall, projections based on wishlist numbers (obviously assuming only a fraction buy the game, but more come in on release) suggest that I’m probably going to make my money back on this project, likely breaking about even after all software, contractor, web, training, artist and marketing costs are covered. To be honest I will see that as a massive result for a first major project so if it comes together I’ll be delighted. Hopefully over a much longer term period I might even have something to show for it.

https://i0.wp.com/gladiatormanager.net/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/JDerrida.png?resize=1024%2C576&ssl=1


Get Involved!

If you’re reading this and don’t have the game on your wishlist, go add it now!

https://i0.wp.com/gladiatormanager.net/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/Result.png?resize=1024%2C577&ssl=1

If you’re a journalist, youtuber, twitcher, influencer etc. – do not hesitate to get in touch with any questions, comments, requests etc.

I can’t wait for release, to see how everyone enjoys the game!

https://i2.wp.com/gladiatormanager.net/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/3v3Moving.png?resize=1024%2C577&ssl=1

notes.title: Release date confirmed!
notes.notes:
It’s official, Gladiator Manager will be released on Steam on 28th January 2021!

I’m glad to say that the game is more or less ready right now, and could perhaps have been released sooner. However, there are many complicated variables going into what makes for a successful release date, and I’m hoping this one will be a good combination of my own availability, low AAA competition and reasonable exposure.

Please get in touch if you are interested in the final beta testing phase.
